description: This file contains internal API prototype declarations for managing an AnscByteArray object, including functions to get/set size, remove elements, access and modify array contents, insert/remove at specific indices, enlarge storage, find data, and manage buffers.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayGetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArraySetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the byte array, expanding or shrinking it.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all elements from the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayGetAt
methods.description: Retrieves the data at a specified index within the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArraySetAt
methods.description: Sets the data at a specific index within the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayInsertAt
methods.description: Inserts data at a specified index, shifting existing elements.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayRemoveAt
methods.description: Removes a number of elements starting from a specified index.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayAdd
methods.description: Appends data to the end of the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayEnlargeStorage
methods.description: Enlarges the storage capacity of the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayFind
methods.description: Finds the index of the specified data within the byte array.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayGetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer at a specified index.

methods.name: AnscByteArraySetBuffer
methods.description: Sets the buffer for the byte array, with foreign buffer support.
